simple.meaning: אָבַךְ (ʼâbak) is a Hebrew action word meaning “probably to coil upward.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Isaiah, beginning at Isaiah 9:17. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אָבַךְ (H55) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: אָבַךְ (ʼâbak) / H55 is traced through Isaiah 9:17 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H55. abak [ אָבַךְ ] verb turn (?) (compare Assyrian Abâku Dl w = הָפַךְ ; Thes MV and others compare בוך ) Hithpa`el וַיִּתְאַבְכוּ Isa 9:17 ; roll, roll up , as volume of smoke (of Israel under figure of thickets of forest) see De & compare הִתִהַמֵּךְ Judg 7:3 .
